name: Salmon floss
summary: Ruốc cá hồi is salmon floss, sold to take home from the Silver Waterfall restaurant and the cold-water fish yard nearby.
origin: Thác Bạc, where the cold-water fish yard also smokes salmon hot and cold.
howToEat: Buy it as a gift to carry home rather than a plate at the table.
where: Nhà hàng thác Bạc near the falls gate, and the cold-water fish yard in tổ 14, Ô Quý Hồ.
seoTitle: Salmon floss in Sapa — a falls-gate gift
seoDescription: Ruốc cá hồi, salmon floss to carry home, from the Silver Waterfall restaurant and the cold-water fish yard.
